name: How do I compare different roofing upgrade estimates?

mainEntity.name: How do I compare different roofing upgrade estimates?

acceptedAnswer.text: When comparing roofing upgrade estimates, look beyond the bottom-line price. Evaluate the scope of work detailed in each estimate, including materials, labor, tear-off and disposal, and warranty information. Check for hidden fees and ensure all estimates cover similar services and material qualities. Discounted Roofing Co. provides a detailed breakdown to ensure transparency. Pay attention to the reputation of the company, their licensing, and insurance, as these factors contribute to the overall value and reliability of the service.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare estimates by evaluating the detailed scope of work, materials, labor, warranties, and hidden fees. Also, consider the company's reputation, licensing, and insurance.
